items.title: U.S., ROK Forces Demonstrate Expeditionary Bulk Fuel Capabilities at CJLOTS 26
items.description:
U.S. and Republic of Korea service members executed a Joint Petroleum Over-the-Shore operation during Combined Joint Logistics Over-the-Shore 26, completing the JPOTS evolution in Pohang, South Korea, July 14, 2026. 

The evolution demonstrated the joint and combined force’s capability to deliver bulk fuel from sea to shore in austere environments, directly supporting the operational readiness and combined interoperability of the ROK-U.S. alliance.
